identity.title: Move Shell pending-edit dialog decision to the Recipe dialog adapter

origin.kind: user continuation request and PL-0016 junior review
origin.summary: The Shell View still contains the pending Recipe edit modal decision and its test queue. The user asked to finish the remaining Shell burden, and the existing RecipeDialogAdapter is the proven UI side-effect owner.

state.current_summary: PL-0017 is verified: the existing RecipeDialogAdapter owns the Shell pending-edit queue and modal decision, the View no longer owns that direct UI state, existing Recipe callback/test contracts are preserved, focused verification passes, and runtime UI/hardware interaction remains unverified.

objective.summary: Make RecipeDialogAdapter the single concrete owner of Shell Recipe modal dialog side effects, including pending-edit decisions and their existing test queue, without changing Recipe command or public test contracts.
